preconditions.description: The size of the array N must be between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(arr[i]) <= 10 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each string in the array must have a length between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(arr, list) and all(isinstance(arr[i], str) for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: The input must be a list of strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if any((arr[i] + arr[j]) == (arr[i] + arr[j])[::-1] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j) else stdout == '0'
postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if there exists a pair of strings that form a palindrome, otherwise '0'.
